transcript.text:
Hi, I'm Sam, Wattle Car Insurance's AI claims assistant. I'm here to help, and you can talk to a person at any time. Just say so.

Before anything else: is anyone hurt, or are you somewhere unsafe right now?

If anyone is hurt or in danger, please call 000 first.

I didn't quite catch that, and that's okay. Let's go one step at a time.

Are you and everyone with you safe right now? You can just reply "yes" or "no".

If it's easier, I can put you through to a person now. Just type "person".

I'm getting a person from our team to help you. They're joining this chat now.

If anyone is hurt or in danger, please call 000 now.

You don't need to type anything else. Just stay with the chat.

input.summary: Customer started a chat with "hhhelp car". They then sent unclear messages ("asdf car thing hmm", "??? the the") and could not answer whether anyone is hurt or in danger. They may be having real trouble communicating, or may be shaken or injured. Not yet verified, no policy details collected. Safety status unknown. I've advised them to call 000 if anyone is hurt or in danger. Please check on their safety first.
